results.question: can I keep a dog in my unit
results.answer:
It depends on the building.

- General Tamam Living rule: Dogs require written approval from building management before the animal enters the building. A maximum of one pet per unit applies, and tenants are responsible for any damage or disturbance caused by their pet.
- Marina Heights addendum: No dogs are permitted in Marina Heights under any circumstances, including registered assistance animals.

results.question: how much notice do I need to give before moving out
results.answer: If your unit is in Marina Heights: 60 days written notice before vacating (the Marina Heights addendum overrides the Tenant Handbook). For other buildings: 90 days written notice before vacating.
